package towerdefense

// 共享金币、地格、路线与命令回执同一事务。失败局部副本丢弃，不能先扣费再异步计算路径。
func (s *State) Apply(id int64, c Command, now int64) (Receipt, bool, error) {
	i := s.Index(id)
	if i < 0 || c.Seq == 0 {
		return Receipt{}, false, ErrRule
	}
	p := &s.Seats[i]
	if c.Epoch != p.Epoch {
		return Receipt{}, false, ErrRule
	}
	if c.Seq <= uint64(len(p.Receipts)) {
		r := p.Receipts[c.Seq-1]
		if r.Command != c {
			return Receipt{}, false, ErrRule
		}
		return r, false, nil
	}
	if c.Seq != uint64(len(p.Receipts)+1) || len(p.Receipts) >= LedgerLimit || s.Phase != "prep" || p.Ready || !p.Connected || c.Round != s.Round || now < s.LastAt || now >= s.Deadline {
		return Receipt{}, false, ErrRule
	}
	switch c.Kind {
	case "build":
		if c.A <= 0 || c.A >= 24 || c.B != 0 || s.Towers[c.A].Level != 0 || s.Gold < s.Rules.BuildCost {
			return Receipt{}, false, ErrRule
		}
		s.Towers[c.A] = Tower{id, 1, s.Rules.BuildCost}
		path := s.Route()
		if len(path) == 0 {
			return Receipt{}, false, ErrRule
		}
		s.Path = path
		s.Gold -= s.Rules.BuildCost
	case "upgrade", "sell":
		if c.A <= 0 || c.A >= 24 {
			return Receipt{}, false, ErrRule
		}
		t := &s.Towers[c.A]
		if t.Owner != id || t.Level != c.B || t.Level == 0 {
			return Receipt{}, false, ErrRule
		}
		if c.Kind == "upgrade" {
			if t.Level >= 3 || s.Gold < 4 {
				return Receipt{}, false, ErrRule
			}
			s.Gold -= 4
			t.Level++
			t.Paid += 4
		} else {
			s.Gold += t.Paid / 2
			*t = Tower{}
			s.Path = s.Route()
		}
	case "ready":
		if c.A != 0 || c.B != 0 {
			return Receipt{}, false, ErrRule
		}
		p.Ready = true
	default:
		return Receipt{}, false, ErrRule
	}
	s.LastAt = now
	all := true
	for _, p := range s.Seats {
		if !p.Ready {
			all = false
		}
	}
	if all {
		s.startWave(now)
	}
	r := Receipt{c, s.Gold, s.Round, s.Phase}
	p.Receipts = append(p.Receipts, r)
	return r, true, s.Validate()
}
func (s *State) Connect(id int64, ticket uint64, connected bool) error {
	i := s.Index(id)
	if i < 0 || ticket == 0 {
		return ErrRule
	}
	p := &s.Seats[i]
	if connected {
		if ticket < p.Epoch {
			return ErrRule
		}
		if ticket == p.Epoch {
			if !p.Connected {
				return ErrRule
			}
			return nil
		}
		p.Epoch = ticket
		p.Connected = true
	} else {
		if ticket != p.Epoch {
			return ErrRule
		}
		p.Connected = false
	}
	return nil
}
func (s *State) startWave(now int64) {
	s.Phase = "battle"
	s.Tick = 0
	s.Deadline = now + s.Rules.TickMillis
	for i := range s.Enemies {
		s.Enemies[i] = Enemy{HP: s.Rules.EnemyHP + s.Round - 1}
	}
}

// 一次 timer 最多计算一个逻辑步。掉线继续已有防御；恢复不按停机秒数追算成百上千步。
func (s *State) Advance(now int64) error {
	if s.Phase == "done" || now < s.Deadline || now >= MaxTime {
		return ErrRule
	}
	s.LastAt = now
	if s.Phase == "prep" {
		s.startWave(now)
	} else {
		s.fightStep(now)
	}
	return s.Validate()
}
func (s *State) fightStep(now int64) {
	s.Tick++
	// 地格升序攻击，优先最接近基地的敌人，同位置按固定敌人索引。没有客户端命中／伤害输入。
	for cell, t := range s.Towers {
		if t.Level == 0 {
			continue
		}
		target := -1
		for i, e := range s.Enemies {
			if e.HP > 0 && distance(cell, s.Path[e.Step]) <= 2 && (target < 0 || e.Step > s.Enemies[target].Step) {
				target = i
			}
		}
		if target >= 0 {
			e := &s.Enemies[target]
			e.HP = max(0, e.HP-2*t.Level)
			if e.HP == 0 {
				s.Killed++
				s.Gold++
			}
		}
	}
	alive := 0
	for i := range s.Enemies {
		e := &s.Enemies[i]
		if e.HP == 0 {
			continue
		}
		if e.Step == len(s.Path)-1 {
			e.HP = 0
			s.BaseHP = max(0, s.BaseHP-2)
			s.Leaked++
		} else {
			e.Step++
			alive++
		}
	}
	if s.BaseHP == 0 {
		s.Phase = "done"
		s.Result = "lost"
		s.Deadline = 0
		return
	}
	if alive == 0 {
		if s.Round == s.Rules.Waves {
			s.Phase = "done"
			s.Result = "won"
			s.Deadline = 0
			return
		}
		s.Round++
		s.Phase = "prep"
		s.Tick = 0
		s.Enemies = [3]Enemy{}
		s.Gold += 6
		for i := range s.Seats {
			s.Seats[i].Ready = false
		}
		s.Deadline = now + s.Rules.PrepMillis
		return
	}
	s.Deadline = now + s.Rules.TickMillis
}
